messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync — Ridgepoint wants a recommended capacity plan for an enterprise commit. Theyre nervous about underprovisioning. Can we list options?

ben_sre: What did presales model?

sara_sales: Presales wrote 32 rps baseline, 50 rps peak, ~130 tokens per request. Model: redwood-gpt-3.2-q. Customer commitment: 20M tokens/month (initial).

omar_infra: Peak token rate = 50*130 = 6500 tps -> ~561.6M tokens/day if sustained. 20M/month is tiny vs peak. We need to recommend (A) baseline reserved pool to cover steady traffic, (B) burst plan with explicit GPU-hour credits, (C) graceful-degrade policy.

liz_prod: Also surface KV cache warmup — for multi-turn sessions, cache hit-rate can cut token cost by ~30% after warmup. Recommend 4-6h preheat; call out shorter preheat risk.

rachel_fin: I’ll prepare two pricing scenarios: baseline reserve sized for 32 rps (monthly cost + overage) and an aggressive reserve for 50 rps (higher monthly fee but fewer burst credits). Include worked example for token overage and GPU-hour burst price.

ben_sre: Autoscale proposal:
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas_reserved: 14
  scale_step: 1
  cpu_target_pct: 70
  cooldown_seconds: 45
  fallback: hosted-burst
```

omar_infra: I will run perf sims for quantized 3.2B on H100 and A100 and post a table mapping rps -> GPUs and expected p50/p95 latencies tomorrow.

ben_sre: Ops checklist for contract: KMS BYOK support? yes for Dedicated/Private. VPC/private endpoint? yes. Audit logs? exportable. Pen tests/SOC2? provide reports. Add lead times (2-3 business days for KMS link).

ops-bot: scheduled job "ridgepoint-smoke" at 2026-04-10T06:00:00Z. Notified: @omar_infra, @ben_sre.

rachel_fin: Legal asked: if reserved pool is exhausted, what happens operationally and what latency guarantees change? We should document routing rules and expected latency bands for reserve vs burst vs smaller-model fallback.

liz_prod: Suggest routing policy snippet to include in MSA: reserved -> quantized-2B fallback (cheap) -> hosted-burst. Also show latency band estimates per tier.

omar_infra: Preheat guidance: default 6h with synthetic replay at 60% token diversity. If customer can’t afford that, document cold-miss frequency and tail latency risk.

ben_sre: Who owns the smoke test? I can run KV-warmup and the 2h 80%-peak smoke if infra reserves slot.

sara_sales: I will get their anonymized 24h traffic sample under NDA today. Rachel, can you finalize pricing scenarios by Monday?

rachel_fin: yes. I’ll include GPU-hour burst pricing, token overage, and an example amortized preheat charge.

liz_prod: I’ll assemble a 1-page runbook for Ridgepoint with: sizing matrix, autoscale YAML, routing fallback, preheat guidance, security answers, and a short checklist for go-live. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

omar_infra: noted. Will post perf sim outputs and a small CSV to this thread.

ben_sre: thumbs up. Once we have the traffic dump we can finalize the reserve recommendation.

sara_sales: thanks team — cc @ridgepoint-sec. Will update here when I have the data. :rocket:
